newsitem.title: JAPAN: Konica to invest 50-70 bln yen in film plant - paper.
newsitem.headline: Konica to invest 50-70 bln yen in film plant - paper.

text.p: Photographic film maker Konica Corp is expected to invest 50 billion to 70 billion yen in building a new plant to boost its output of photographic film and other photosensitive materials, a Japanese business daily said on Friday.
Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the new plant is expected to be built in Japan, aiming to start operations around the year 2000.
The estimate of Konica's investment does not include the cost of acquiring land but only covers buildings and equipment for the plant, the paper said.
Konica was not immediately available for comment on the report.
Despite the launch of new photographic equipment such as digital cameras, Konica sees demand for conventional silver-based photographic films continuing to grow, particularly in Asia, the paper said.
